_comment: Example registry. The interview in AGENT.md generates a real registry.json from your answers. Paths are relative to this hub directory. Fill 'remote' to allow setup on a machine where the repos are not yet present.

dispatch._comment: Event-driven dispatcher tunables (scripts/bizagent-dispatch.sh). Enable via scripts/install-dispatch.sh — installation is a deliberate manual step.

hub_agent._comment: Optional hub PTL agent for event-driven dispatch (bizagent-watch.sh). Enable via scripts/install-watch.sh and set prompt + optional model. If absent, hub inbox is not watched.
hub_agent.prompt: You are the hub PTL agent. Read inbox/*.md for incoming messages, process each one, then archive it. After processing all messages, send a single PushNotification with status=proactive summarizing what arrived and what you did.
